evaluation.contrast_and_controls: Freeze record/source/reference snapshots, namespaces, eligibility and time scope; version candidate generation, ID rules, scoring, resolution and lifecycle state. Use the same independently reviewed units for supported pre/post contrasts. Separate source-mix change from within-old-population deterioration; do not compare unadjusted aggregate pre/post rates with different denominators. Do not force identical candidate pools when measuring the full onboarding intervention.
evaluation.frames_and_denominators: Define semantic pairspace U and each arm's asserted pairs A intersected with U. For partition outputs, A includes induced co-memberships, not just scored edges. Sample across the union of arms' accepted outputs with known support to estimate each arm's precision. Population recall requires review support throughout U, including outside both candidate pools and a residual stratum; candidate-only review cannot identify it. Report new-source slices separately. Entity-quality claims require independently complete membership evidence and are deferred here.
evaluation.review_and_split: Declare strata before final annotation, covering old/old and new-source interactions, ID/name-address disagreements, missingness and candidate status as applicable. Preserve all selection and response dispositions, unknowns and reviewer evidence; blind system predictions where feasible. Audit entity/context leakage; keep final review inaccessible to tuning and targeted acquisition.
evaluation.metrics_and_uncertainty: Report weighted false-assertion/precision estimates only where design and outcomes support them, paired differences, slice coverage, unresolved mass, review cost and diagnostic error discoveries. Recall remains unsupported unless its wider frame is feasible. Follow actual strata/stages and paired sampling design for uncertainty; assess reviewer error and unresolved-outcome sensitivity separately. No observed errors is not zero risk; no numeric results or thresholds are invented.
evaluation.criteria_and_next_decision: Owner must predeclare practical deterioration margins, decision-precision targets and high-harm/cost limits. Supported deterioration beyond the margin or unacceptable harm warrants an authorized mitigation investigation, not an automatic rollback. Supported non-deterioration within declared guardrails can support only the scoped continuation decision, not universal safety. Wide intervals, zero-support slices or conclusions reversible by unresolved labels are inconclusive: collect the smallest additional authorized evidence or narrow the claim. Current outcome is inconclusive; no experiment was executed.

baseline.configuration: Existing accepted-edge policy followed by connected components on a fixed eligible record universe, including isolated records; preserve unresolved status where appropriate.
baseline.mechanism: Every accepted path induces co-membership, even for unscored endpoints. Closure cannot use contrary evidence once links are accepted.
baseline.prerequisites: Audited same-as semantics and time scope, stable identifiers and edge provenance, no ignored mandatory restrictions.
baseline.costs_and_failures: Transparent fixed-graph traversal but potentially large false-merge amplification; missing paths can fragment people. Edge deletion may not split a component because alternate paths remain; union-only state cannot undo merges.

alternative.name: Selective verification and conservative edge admission followed by unchanged connected components
alternative.intervention: Change admission only: under a predeclared review budget, independently verify high-exposure links and defer unresolved admissions in shadow. Keep records, candidates, scores and closure rule fixed. Any threshold sensitivity arm is a separate admission-policy comparison.
alternative.prerequisites: Edge provenance, score semantics, independent adjudication, review budget and explicit unresolved-state policy.
alternative.costs_and_failures: Review cost and added latency; false deferrals can break legitimate chains. Targeted review yield is not population precision. Smaller components, fewer bridges or fewer contradictions are not evidence of improved accuracy.

alternative.name: Conservative sorted feasible merging with audited whole-union constraints
alternative.intervention: Change membership only on the same fixed admitted-edge evidence and scores. Initialize audited must-link closure, reject infeasible initial groups, then process optional merges with declared ordering and tie rules; veto a proposed union if any whole-cluster hard restriction fails. This is not connected components on a pruned-edge graph and not merely an admission threshold change.
alternative.prerequisites: Confirmed DEC-01-001 identity contract; independently validated restrictions with owners, provenance and time scope. No such restrictions are established by the scenario, so this arm is conditional, not ready for deployment.
alternative.costs_and_failures: Constraint auditing and whole-union checks add work; greedy order affects results; bad restrictions systematically undermerge. Same-source membership, weak identifier mismatches, absent candidates and low scores do not automatically establish cannot-links. Constraint satisfaction alone is not accuracy. A soft partition objective is a further possible comparison, not justified complexity at this stage.

evaluation.status: Plan only; no graph computation, adjudication, benchmark or quality evaluation was run.
evaluation.controls: Use identical eligible records, identity/time semantics, candidate and score versions. Run the admission intervention separately from fixed-edge membership intervention; freeze audited constraints within membership comparisons. evaluation.without_labels: Report component-size tails, bridge/articulation exposure, source mixtures, growth, contradictions, score-margin sensitivity, refusal attribution, review coverage and cost with explicit denominators. These diagnose fragility, not identity precision/recall. Compare true sparse-chain and dense-incorrect-union witnesses as behavioral checks only, not population evidence.
evaluation.label_acquisition_and_split: Seek independent adjudication that distinguishes same, different and unknown within the declared person/time scope. Keep risk-targeted cases for mechanism diagnosis separate from a probability-based acquisition design for population claims. For accuracy estimates obtain a complete reference partition on a bounded universe or fully resolved sampled entities with design-aware estimators, inspecting predicted-cluster intersections and omissions. Split whole entities from tuning for new-identity transfer, or use later observations with admissible historical state for continuation. If labels remain partial, report only supported bounds or case-specific outcomes; do not label unknown cross-boundary pairs negative.
evaluation.metrics: When supported by reference coverage: induced-pair precision/recall, record-averaged B-cubed with stated denominators, fragmentation, foreign-record contamination, largest supported erroneous merge, affected records, application-weighted harm, review cost and membership churn. Count distinct swallowed identities only if foreign membership is adjudicated or bounded. Include source/new-source and component-risk slices rather than averages alone.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use paired design-aware comparisons respecting entity/cluster dependence, strata and weights; not an iid pair bootstrap. Explicitly report reference coverage, unknowns and limited support for rare catastrophic events.
evaluation.success_and_falsification: Before outcome inspection, domain owners must set practical false-merge-harm improvement margins, catastrophic-error limits and denominators, acceptable fragmentation/recall loss and review cost. Do not invent numerical thresholds. Improvement requires independently supported reduced entity harm with guardrails met, not just smaller graphs. Increased fragmentation, persistent verified contamination or gains disappearing under representative adjudication falsify the corresponding benefit claim.
evaluation.next_decisions: Positive evidence supports only the measured shadow scope and a request for explicit further authorization, never automatic production mutation. Negative evidence favors retaining the comparator or revising the mechanism. Inconclusive evidence requires targeted evidence acquisition or a narrower bounded claim, not a complex resolver winner.
evaluation.guardrails: No live edge removals, entity splits, ID changes, master-field changes or publication. Quarantine unresolved hard-constraint conflicts in shadow; stop before high-harm or irreversible effects.

alternative.costs_and_failures: Tiling bounds resident work but does not reduce inherent pair count or guarantee the deadline. Excessively small tiles add scheduling and I/O; large tiles retain stragglers. Same-shard-only comparison loses cross-shard pairs; successful tiles may still omit required feature routes. Retries, replication, floating-point order, null/collation differences and local-only resolution can invalidate the claimed equivalence.
alternative.lossy_boundary: A later name-plus-locality refinement or hot-key cap would be a separately authorized DEC-05-001 candidate experiment, not the initial alternative. It can remove genuine matches and change candidate composition/calibration even with an unchanged scorer. Incomplete labels do not justify deploying it.

evaluation.initial_route: EVAL-11-007 (evaluation/execution-cost-replay.md), with EVAL-11-001 (evaluation/candidate-recall.md) for candidate accounting and any separately authorized retrieval changes.
evaluation.comparator_and_controls: Compare the current execution and bounded batching/tiling on the same declared logical workload. Freeze representations, records, eligibility, union/dedup, required routes, scorer, resolution and policies. Freeze realized stochastic outputs if applicable. Counterbalance run order, disclose resource contention/profiling overhead, separate cold build from warm reuse, and retain all failed attempts under prespecified retry rules.
evaluation.completion_and_outputs: Name and compare joint candidate sets, route-specific evidence/dispositions and applicable assignments/memberships, master views and IDs. Require set-level required-unit reconciliation or an independently justified coverage argument; equal counts or successful task status alone are insufficient. Report unresolved, failed and pending units, duplicate/conflicting products and physical retries separately. Define the exact semantic or byte-level equivalence promise and permitted numerical/order variation in advance.
evaluation.cost_metrics: Measure input scan/index build, emitted versus unique candidates, overlap by pass, block/degree tails, required and completed logical units, end-to-end latency through consistent committed output, task tails and maximum, peak memory, spill/storage/network, external calls and total resource cost. Keep throughput credit conditional on valid completion and promised equivalence; no numeric targets are supplied here.
evaluation.labels_and_split: Incomplete labels do not block physical output-equivalence tests, but they block unsupported population-recall or precision claims. For a later candidate change, obtain independent positives or defensible entity-centric/outside-candidate review with a declared search boundary, sampling frame and inclusion probabilities. Unknown pairs remain unknown. If retrieval is tuned, separate evaluation entities for new-identity transfer, or use deployment-admissible later observations for continuation without future-label feedback.
evaluation.candidate_diagnostics: Under EVAL-11-001, report eligible pair universe, final unique scored candidate set, reduction, known-positive yield with its limited scope, deduplicated marginal pass contribution and leave-one-pass-out diagnostics. Slice by source pair, key frequency/common-name blocks and missingness; add other slices only if relevant and observable. Use independent outside-candidate truth for recall denominators. Do not infer population recall from labels collected only inside the old union.
evaluation.uncertainty: Prespecify repeated complete-run design and practical equivalence/cost/freshness margins. Use matched run comparisons where valid and distinguish workload-conditional runtime variability from generalization. Candidate-quality intervals must follow the actual entity/pair sampling design; do not default to independent-pair resampling. Insufficient precision or unknown completion semantics is inconclusive, not equivalence.
evaluation.decision_rules: Positive: consider the physical alternative only if complete reconciled outputs meet predeclared equivalence and the actual batch deadline/resource margins at worthwhile total cost. Negative: retain the baseline and investigate the measured remaining bottleneck if complete equivalence holds but cost/deadline does not improve; reject omissions or divergent global decisions. Inconclusive: acquire missing manifests, semantic contracts, repeated-run evidence or outside-candidate truth rather than declare a winner. Missing authority or unsafe publication stops action.
evaluation.execution_status: No implementation, workload execution, synthetic test or quality evaluation performed. No outcomes or numerical margins invented.
